caption: The drawing depicts a garment resembling a cape or mantle, primarily colored in shades of dark green with subtle hints of yellow and brown highlighting its contours and folds. The cape features a high collar and an ornate, decorative trim in a darker green that outlines the collar, front opening, hem, and arm openings. The inside lining of the cape is a contrasting light yellow, visible near the arm openings and lower edge. The main visible section of the cape shows clean, smooth surfaces with a gentle gradient of green hues. To the upper right of the main image, there is a secondary outline sketch of the same cape, showing the shape from the rear and side without color or detailed decoration. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with minimal shading or texture.
title: Dolman
